messages: Maya Chen: Quick check: propose replacing 'Stop' with 'Capture snapshot' in the playground stream so partial output becomes a standalone message. Thoughts? Devin Patel: Strong 👍. Keyboard mapping idea: Esc toggles live/pause. What should regenerate do—append or replace? Maya Chen: Suggest regenerate appends a new message. Provide an explicit 'Replace snapshot' action if they want to overwrite. Sasha Rivera: Microcopy nit: 'Replace snapshot' OK. A11y: announce "Snapshot captured" once via polite aria-live; avoid spamming updates while streaming. Alan Ng: Token counter placement: compact right-aligned pill in message footer. Hover/focus reveals cost. Keep it out of the header. Jyoti Rao: Token pill a11y: 4.5:1 contrast, keyboard-focusable, aria-label like 'Message tokens: 42', and use aria-describedby for cost text so SRs read it on demand. No live announcements on partial updates. Devin Patel: Add 300ms debounce on capture to prevent double taps and a quick visual flash animation. Prompt shelf filter debounce 200ms. Playground Bot: TokenEstimator: last partial = 42 tokens; est cost $0.00021. Maya Chen: Can system chips (like bot status) be styled as low-visibility and excluded from exports by default? Snapshots included. Sasha Rivera: Yes — add export toggle 'Include system metadata'. Toast microcopy: 'Prompt inserted — Undo'. After insert, return focus to composer. Alan Ng: Prototype HTML: `` and `Estimated cost $0.00021`. Jyoti Rao: Good. Ensure the described cost reads only on focus. I'll write the a11y acceptance criteria and test steps. Devin Patel: I'll implement keyboard shortcuts, capture debounce, and the undo toast. Maya Chen: Action items: Alan prototype pill + animation; Devin prompt-shelf nav + undo; Jyoti a11y checklist; Sasha microcopy final. I'll update Figma after prototypes. :sparkles:
